projects.title: HitLimit
projects.tagline: The fastest way to say no
projects.description: High-performance rate limiting middleware for modern web frameworks. 2-7M ops/sec with memory store, sub-millisecond latency, and native Bun support. Zero runtime dependencies, ~7KB bundle size, and built-in SaaS tier support. What takes competitors 25+ lines, HitLimit does in 8.

projects.title: Kaput
projects.description: Graceful shutdown for Node.js without the boilerplate. One import, zero config. Auto-detects HTTP servers, databases, and message queues. Kubernetes-ready health checks out of the box. Supports Express, Fastify, Prisma, Redis, BullMQ, Mongoose, and Knex. 50+ lines of shutdown logic, gone.

projects.title: CareerAI
projects.description: Your AI-powered career co-pilot. CareerAI helps professionals create comprehensive profiles, find opportunities that actually match their skills, and prepare for interviews with personalized coaching. Built with Claude Sonnet 4.5 for intelligent job matching, automated resume generation, and application tracking that doesn't suck.

projects.title: BunWay
projects.description: We missed Express ergonomics on Bun's native runtime. So we built BunWay — a lightweight HTTP router with familiar routing patterns, middleware support, and path parameter parsing. Open source. Published on npm. Used by developers who want Express DX with Bun performance.

projects.title: Honeycomb Protocol
projects.description: Built the core protocol infrastructure that blockchain games run on. Not a wrapper or SDK — actual protocol-level Solana programs handling asset management, player profiles, and on-chain game state. Multiple game studios now build on top of this foundation.

projects.title: GameShift
projects.tagline: Developer platform for Web3 game integration
projects.description: Built the developer platform that makes blockchain integration painless for game studios. Comprehensive APIs for wallet connection, NFT mechanics, in-game economies, and asset management — all production-ready and battle-tested.

projects.title: NFT Ecosystem Work
projects.tagline: Staking, missions, and gamification for 7+ collections
projects.description: During the NFT wave, we built the infrastructure that made collections engaging. Staking systems, mission mechanics, raffle platforms, and gamified holder experiences for The Fracture, Sol Patrol, DRiP Binary Force, Wobblebug, Drippieverse, Pooks, and OKD.

projects.title: Client Projects
projects.tagline: From startups to enterprises across 30+ countries
projects.description: Years of completed projects with a 4.8 rating on Fiverr. Clients from 30+ countries. From quick fixes to full-scale platforms, we've delivered across every timezone. Each project added to our expertise, each client became a reference.
